title: fix: correct observability dashboard numbers and drop legacy dashboards
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Observability dashboards now count successful calls and funded users and apps, excluding 402 rejections. For the cited 30-day period, platform calls change from 15.8M to 5.9M successful calls and active users from 24.2k to 19.7k; WAU for the week to Oct 4 changes from 9.1k to 7.2k, while the KPI shows 7.4k. The former 1,635 active-model count is replaced by separate counts of 224 Pollinations models and 1,156 community models with at least one successful call. Dashboards now show the last 30 complete UTC days (`now-30d/d` to `now-1d/d`) and refresh hourly, avoiding partial first and last bars in kiosk mode. Removed 12 unused legacy dashboards and their Tinybird Stripe and Tinybird Legacy datasources. Removed three blank observed-balance panels from Users & Balances because Grafana cannot read their internal pipe; a test now rejects dashboards that read pipes under `enter.pollinations.ai/observability/pipes/`. Pinned `grafana-clickhouse-datasource` to 4.22.1 so restarts do not pick up newer plugin releases.

The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny accountant glasses, stays small-to-medium beside the robot, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with warm cream and lavender surroundings and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
